assetMap.description: Release file glob per target. Keys: windows, linux, windows-x64, linux-x86-dynamic, linux-static… A plain "windows"/"linux" key is the 32-bit build.

version.description: Project version (informative). Packages are versioned by their Git tags.

entry.description: Main .pwn file (e.g. gamemodes/main.pwn). Used when compiling a file no entry file includes.

output.description: Generated .amx file (default: next to the entry).

dependencies.description: GitHub packages: { "user/repo": "requirement" }. Installed into dependencies/ and locked in pawn-lock.json.

devDependencies.description: Packages used only during development (tests, debugging tools).

include.description: For package authors: folder(s) with the .inc files this package exports. Use { "samp": ..., "openmp": ... } when each server has its own include. Default: detected.

plugins.description: For package authors: release file(s) with the binaries per target (SA-MP plugins, or archives with plugins/ and components/ inside), or false when the package has no binaries. Default: detected from the release file names.

supports.description: For package authors: servers this package is made for. Default: both. An open.mp-only package is not installed on SA-MP servers; a SA-MP plugin is loaded by open.mp as a legacy plugin.

components.description: For package authors: release file(s) with the open.mp component, only when it is a different file from "plugins". open.mp servers download this one instead.

target.description: For projects: which builds packages install. Default: the server found in the project, this machine's system, 32-bit, default build.

server.description: Server the packages are for (default: detected from samp-server / omp-server).

os.description: System of the server (e.g. linux when you develop on Windows and deploy to Linux).

arch.description: Architecture (default x86: SA-MP and open.mp load 32-bit plugins).

variant.description: Build variant when the package offers several, e.g. "dynamic" (dynssl) or "static".

compiler.description: For projects: compiler settings of this project. They win over the pawnStudio.* settings. Paths are relative to pawn.json.

path.description: pawncc to use (file or folder), e.g. "pawno/pawncc.exe".

includes.description: Extra include folders (before the pawnStudio.includePaths setting).
